summary: Iteration 7: Complete testing of Products page, Purchase Orders page, Technicians route fix, and sidebar updates. All 21 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend features verified working correctly.
passed_tests: === Backend API Tests (21/21 passed) ===
GET /api/technicians/overview - returns array (route ordering fix verified)
GET /api/technicians/overview - each tech has computed stats (assigned, open, no_notes, overdue, resolved, hours_this_week)
GET /api/technicians/{id}/dashboard - returns tech info, stats, and ticket lists
GET /api/products - returns products list
GET /api/products/categories - returns category list
POST /api/products - creates new product
GET /api/products/{id} - returns single product
PUT /api/products/{id} - updates product and persists changes
GET /api/products?search= - search functionality works
GET /api/products?category= - filter by category works
DELETE /api/products/{id} - deletes product
GET /api/purchase-orders/stats - returns PO statistics
GET /api/purchase-orders - returns PO list
POST /api/purchase-orders - creates PO with line items
GET /api/purchase-orders/{id} - returns single PO
PUT /api/purchase-orders/{id} status=submitted - workflow draft->submitted
PUT /api/purchase-orders/{id} status=received - workflow submitted->received
GET /api/purchase-orders?search= - search POs works
GET /api/purchase-orders?status= - filter by status works
DELETE /api/purchase-orders/{id} - deletes PO
